versions.content: A call to J1939Nm_NetworkRelease shall set all NodeChannels of the reported channel to ‘ Sleep Mode’. The J1939 Network M anagement module shall notify this mode change to the NM Interface via Nm_BusSleepMode , and shall report a state change to ‘SleepMode’ to the NM Interface via Nm_StateChangeNotification(NM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP) and to BswM via BswM_J1939Nm_StateChangeNotificati on(NM_STATE_BUS_SLEEP) .
